text:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up for streaming/chat: we need clear owners, target dates, and rollback criteria. Main areas: reconnect/backoff defaults, server-side partial short-circuit, telemetry + alerts, repro harness, canary + comms.

trent: I can own reconnect/backoff in SDK + handshake retry policy on runtime. Plan: RFC by 2026-03-29, implement by 2026-04-04, canary 2026-04-08. Default: exp backoff, max_attempts=5, jitter ~10-20%.

sophia: Observability lead. I'll add metric stream.partial_rate (per-route/model), handshake latency p50/p95/p99, and an alert: partial_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m OR >1% spike. Dashboard + runbook before canary. Target: 2026-03-28.

li: I'll produce a small repro harness that injects truncated chunks and simulated network flaps. Deliver nightly CI job and a minimal repro script to attach to the ticket. Target: 2026-03-26.

trent: config sample for review:
```json
{"streaming": {"client_reconnect": {"enabled": true, "strategy": "exp", "initial_ms": 100, "max_ms": 1600, "max_attempts": 5, "jitter_fraction": 0.15}}}
```
Keeping conservative defaults but tunable.

ops-bot: Tickets created: RW-STREAM-900 (owner: trent), RW-STREAM-901 (owner: sophia), RW-STREAM-902 (owner: li).

maya: Server short-circuit behavior: if partials > threshold for same request, mark event partial_shortcircuit=true, trigger safe-fallback (no progressive retries), and persist request KV snapshot in logs for 30s for triage. Product comms draft required before customer-visible canary.

sophia: I'll tag logs with partial_shortcircuit and add trace span. Dashboard will include request-id drilldown for KV snapshot links.

trent: Note runtime concern: reconnect storms could starve continuous batching. I'll sync with eng-runtime tomorrow and add a throttle guard in SDK if needed.

canary-bot: Planned canary: 2026-04-08 02:00-06:00 UTC (region: us-west1). Auto-rollback if partial_rate > 0.9% or handshake p99 increases >100ms.

maya: Closure criteria: PRs merged, canary stable 48h with metric improvement vs baseline, telemetry kept 14d, then retrospective and close items. Growth to draft customer comms pre-canary.

li: ACK — will attach repro and nightly CI to RW-STREAM-902.

sophia: ACK — linking dashboard/runbook to RW-STREAM-901 before canary.

trent: ACK — RFC PR opening now and will link to RW-STREAM-900.

maya: Thanks team. 15m sync Friday to confirm readiness.
